why: Both themes involve attacks, rallies and retaliation, and a room may defend its own work while also striking back at rivals, so the defender/attacker boundary is easy to blur.

why.T3-050: The item is dominated by hockey taunts and insults traded with Leafs visitors in the attack thread.
why.T3-155: The closing gg, farewell and barbed good-luck passages salute the rival after the fight, which T3-050's taunting gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: A single T3-050 placement would carry the taunts and insults but would fail to carry the post-fight gg, farewell and good-luck sign-off.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0669763 lol gg, C0732489 See you all in Buffalo next year, and C0459481 Goodluck in the playoffs you northern gentleman are salutes to the rival after the exchange.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-155 if forced to one; the taunting is the larger part, but the friendly sign-off would be lost.

why.T3-028: The item is about offering, running, distributing and detecting scripts or bots for the fox build, not about arguing their fairness as such.

why.T3-092: The repeated My small contribution posts are one member's small piece made alone and reported.
why.T3-029: The later passages mourn the lost contribution and consider making another image elsewhere, which T3-092's gate does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-092 carries the lone small tribute and report but not the grief for the overwritten contribution.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0503028 voices RIP and thinks of making another image somewhere, which is mourning a lost work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-029 if forced to one; the small-contribution practice is the main material, but the mourning would be lost.

why.T3-033: The main doing is a member proposing the CLC tag and calling the room to make it.
why.T3-020: Finding the black border and placing the tag there is choosing a canvas spot, which T3-033 does not carry.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-033 carries the proposed mark, scale and preview but not the choice of where on the canvas it should go.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0170614 finds a good place and C0491768 places the tag in the top left black border, which is choosing a spot.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-020 if forced to one; the proposal is central, but the location choice would be lost.

why.T3-091: The item redirects duplicate number-making back to the already existing numbers and asks helpers to maintain that one plan, rather than gathering posts or arguing design.

why.T3-004: The item is entirely about how the visible mark should look: Noodle's colour and mouth, lettering pixels, a gold tooth, a rainbow and unwanted pupils.

why.T3-023: The sub is turned into a rainbow/unicorn takeover and members play inside it with flairs, banners, role-play and bargaining.
why.T3-095: Several passages explicitly work out whether the change is an April Fools joke by checking the date and calling it April Fools.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-023 carries the takeover and play inside it but not the repeated attempts to settle whether the change is an April Fools joke.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0860684 guesses April fools day, C1086937 points to the date, C1114075 asks if it is an April Fools thing, C0406123 and C1315031 settle it as April Fools.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-095 if forced to one; the takeover play is the main material, but the date-checking and April-Fools settling would be lost.

why.T3-005: The osu logo is attacked and the room rallies, fights back and reports holding out against raids.
why.T3-050: The item is full of taunts and mockery traded with Tyler1's community during the conflict.
why.T3-058: Later explanations and curses allocate blame to Tyler1, his chat and the raid after the event.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 carries the defence of the osu logo but not the taunts and mockery aimed at the rival community.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1100883, C0329435, C1298889, C1106540 and C1390158 are direct taunts and insults traded with Tyler1's community.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-050 if forced to two; the defence is primary, but the taunting texture would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-005 carries the live defence but not the later blame-laying against Tyler1 and his chat.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1324304, C0033298, C0605808, C1309944 and C1207310 explain and blame Tyler1, his chat or his followers for the raid.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-058 if forced to two; the defence and taunts are more central, but the post-hoc blame would be lost.

why.T3-031: The meme-song cover is the room's own running joke and April Fools in-joke, made and received inside the sub.
why.T3-064: The cover is then carried out to r/LoveLiveCovers with a request for credited reposting and a reminder to cross-post.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-031 carries the in-joke and meme-song making inside the room but not the cross-posting of that joke to another sub.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0847827 asks to repost on r/LoveLiveCovers with credit, C0998123 posts it themselves, and C0775623 thanks the reminder to cross-post.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-064 if forced to one; the meme-song making is the bulk, but the cross-sub spread would be lost.

why.T3-004: The item is a bag: it heavily argues the Straw Hat mark's look, especially red eyes/pupils, and also carries spam complaints, canvas-worth dismissal, repair/defence and flood objection. T3-004 is placed as the most concept-rich single theme; T3-075, T3-037, T3-021 and T3-005 are present at the three-concept floor.

why.T3-070: The main practical work is circulating guides, templates, overlays, outlines and refresh instructions for the Blue Note.
why.T3-091: Several posts explicitly tell everyone to follow one guide or graph because placers are scattered.
why.T3-022: The item also includes proposing and recounting a relocation and a smaller restart after conflict over the spot.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070 carries the shared guides and templates but not the insistence on one official plan against scattered placers.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0473718 tells everyone to follow one guide, C0982607 says sticking to the graph is more important, and C0017668 asks for refresh so the same-color work is not duplicated.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-091 if forced to two; templates are central, but the one-plan enforcement would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-070 carries the template work but not the relocation/restart after conflict over the original spot.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0124218 proposes moving because osu will not give up its spot, C0649372 recounts the move as a total restart, and C0908564 abandons the move when original progress resumes.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-022 if forced to two; the shared plan is the main work, but the relocation strand would be lost.

why.T3-043: Both passages give thanks or credit to helpers of the flag effort, including one individual who joined.
why.T3-072: One passage specifically thanks r/placehearts as another room for the canvas, which T3-043's own-makers credit gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-043 carries thanks to a helper but not the public thanks to another room as an ally.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1140018 shouts out r/placehearts for creating the canvas for the flag.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-072 if forced to one; the individual thanks is the smaller material, but the inter-room credit would be lost.

why.T3-095: The clip is introduced as a possible April Fools joke and the discussion settles whether the failed shots are a joke, blanks or a real hit-registration bug.

why.T3-041: The room repeatedly proposes extending or enlarging its UCF work with a Pegasus, Charge On, or a bigger logo.
why.T3-061: Several proposals push into a neighbour's space, taking Unturned's spot or covering the green face/UF.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-041 carries adding pieces and enlarging the room's work but not taking a neighbour's space.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1212559 insists on taking Unturned's spot, C0602469 plans an FSU logo over the green face, and C1507710 says UCF should have covered UF.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: Drop T3-061 if forced to one; the extension proposals are the main material, but the expansion into neighbours would be lost.

why.T3-017: The passages are ordinary team/player talk about the Sedins pranking Stecher, with no canvas work or staged April Fools fake in the sub.
